title: Agreement on a finite segment
statement: Let $\mu,\mu' : \mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $b\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of integers. Suppose that $\mu'$ agrees with $\mu$ at every natural number satisfying a predicate $K$, and that $K(b+i)$ holds for every index $i<|l|$. If $\mu(b+i)=l_i$ for every such index, then $\mu'(b+i)=l_i$ for every such index.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ agrees with the list $l$ at each position starting at $b$
